{{Quote|You're on report the moment we land!|Mallop, to Flight Lieutenant Rignik|<ref name="DVT" />}}
'''Mallop''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE pilot]] [[Flight Commander/Legends|Flight Commander]] who flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], Mallop was among the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] patrolling outside the planet who escorted the departing [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. Mallop and the other pilots were shortly afterward ordered to pursue the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which was attempting to escape Imperial clutches on Bespin.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Back off.|Boba Fett, to Mallop and the other TIE pilots|<ref name="DVT" />}}
Mallop was a [[TIE pilot]] [[Flight Commander/Legends|Flight Commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. He flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], and [[Flight Lieutenant]] [[Rignik]] reported to him.<ref name="DVT" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], intending to capture the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> When [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who had aided the Empire during Bespin's occupation, left the planet aboard his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], Mallop was among the four [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]&mdash;initially on a routine patrol&mdash;who approached ''Slave I'' as it headed towards the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] outside Bespin.<ref name="DVT" />

[[File:RarrExecutorSMASH-ESBHD.jpg|thumb|right|320px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' escaping pursuing TIE/LN starfighters outside Bespin]]
When the TIE/LN starfighters accelerated to match the speed of ''Slave I'', Fett warned them to slow down. Mallop and the other TIE pilots remained following ''Slave I'' only at maximum range before the latter [[Starship/Legends|ship]] jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. However, Mallop and the other pilots' return to their normal patrol routes was very short-lived before the group received new orders to pursue the ''Millennium Falcon'' as it was approaching them from Bespin. When Rignik nervously asked about the ''Falcon''{{'s}} history in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] and the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mallop disciplined his subordinate and said that the latter would be on report upon them landing.<ref name="DVT" /> Ultimately, it was TIE/LN starfighters from the Imperial [[Obsidian Squadron/Legends|Obsidian Squadron]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|402|Obsidian Squadron}}</ref> that pursued the ''Falcon'' out of Bespin and into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] before the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] instead escaped Imperial clutches.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Shaddup!|Mallop, roaring to Rignik|<ref name="DVT" />}}
Mallop and the other TIE pilots were relieved when Boba Fett's ''Slave I'' jumped into hyperspace and they no longer had to escort the latter ship. When Rignik mentioned the history of the ''Millennium Falcon'', Mallop first roared to his subordinate to shut up, before saying he meant to order Rignik to keep silence over the TIE pilots' communication systems. In a private transmission to Rignik, Mallop went on to say the latter would be on report upon landing.<ref name="DVT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Michael Stern]] created Mallop for "[[Dark Voyage to Tatooine]]," a story published in [[1990]] in [[West End Games]]' [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''.<ref name="DVT" />
